layout_sources: No importer config or help page for this export could be reached in this session; the layout is the widely circulated comdirect "Umsätze" CSV as quoted in user forums and import scripts (title row, "Neuer Kontostand" above the table, "Alter Kontostand" below it)
notes: Umsätze CSV of the Girokonto: a row holding only ";", a title row with the period, "Neuer Kontostand" (the closing balance with " EUR"), an empty row, then the 5-column header; every field double-quoted and every row ending in ";"; Windows-1252, CRLF, dd.mm.yyyy, a signed "Umsatz in EUR" with dot thousands and a comma decimal; the counterparty and purpose are packed into Buchungstext ("Auftraggeber: ... Buchungstext: ... Ref. ..."); newest first; after an empty row "Alter Kontostand", the opening balance. File name umsaetze_<Kontonummer>_<yyyymmdd-hhmm>.csv. From memory of circulated samples, not a source checked here.
